description: Cross-entity search across stories, features, decisions, documents, notes, observations, and session summaries. Three retrieval modes: query (FTS5/tsvector keyword), semantic (Gemini cosine over entity_embeddings — VP-1185), and reindex (backfill the index). Semantic mode does hybrid retrieval: cosine similarity + keyword via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (60% semantic / 40% keyword). Returns Layer-1 progressive disclosure: agent hydrates full content via existing tools.

embedder_version.description: Embedder version to query (default: gemini-text-embedding-001) (for: semantic)

entity_types.description: Restrict to a subset of entity types (for: query, semantic)

limit.description: Max results (default 10 for semantic, 20 for query) (for: query, semantic)

project_id.description: Project ID (for: query, reindex, semantic — auto-detected if omitted)

name: search
